family.description: Several proteins in this family form iron-sulfur clusters enabling iron dependent DNA transcription regulation [[cite:PUB00109206]]. The iron binding is mediated by three conserved cysteine residues. Members of this family can also bind O-acetyl-L-serine, [Fe-S] and nitric oxide (Matilla et. al., FEMS Microbiology Reviews, fuab043, 45, 2021, 1. https://doi.org/10.1093/femsre/fuab043).
family.name: Iron-dependent Transcriptional regulator
